name: Lucy
source: Lucy is the daughter of Professor [url=/c89743]Anna[/url], she is a smart but discreet girl. She has slight depression that can become more serious if she's disappointed or subjected to a lot of stress. She is [url=/c89739]Floyd[/url]'s classmate.
